{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
data_clean = data[
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & 
    (data['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check for any remaining issues in the cleaned data
print("Cleaned data shape:", data_clean.shape)
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(data_clean['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(data_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if the channels differ systematically in customer_segment
print("\nChannel vs Customer Segment cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']))

# Check if the channels differ in conversion rate without adjusting for segment
print("\nRaw conversion rates by channel:")
print(data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())

# Compute the adjusted conversion rate by segment
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean())"}
